verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a travel and expense SaaS that handles employee and spend data, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only retrieval and update APIs, MCP querying, and SSO-scoped permissions. Nothing covers retention policies, deletion of user or transaction data, or how data accessed through AI assistants is retained.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
